summary: Frontend-only iteration_5 testing (Expo web preview @ 390x844). All 11 distinct navigation pathways from home (6 nodes + 5 tabs + Review Takes) resolve to 11 unique URLs with correct per-screen testIDs (record-screen, neural-screen, mixer-screen, reel-screen, collab-screen, tuner-screen, metronome-screen, looper-screen, songbook-screen, setlists-screen). Jam pathway works: JAM NOW -> /jam exposes jam-tuner + jam-metronome, both navigate to their respective tools. Metronome: bpm-plus/minus updates bpm-value (100 -> 102 -> 101), metronome-toggle starts/stops without crash, beat dots render. Tuner: all 6 string chips (tuner-string-0..5) tap and update selection. Login shows brand-wordmark with a real single lemniscate infinity (SVG Path, not two circles) plus 'Welcome back' on the smooth blue nebula background - no literal black box (dark navy glass card is per spec). Home shows GROOVLABZ PRESENTS, GR-infinity-VSESH wordmark, real Flying-V guitar image, 7 glowing node buttons, and 6-tab bottom bar. Sign Up creates account and lands on home. Settings -> Upgrade to Pro -> /paywall?reason=settings renders GroovSesh Pro with Monthly $9.99 and Yearly $79.99 offerings + Restore Purchases. Sign Out returns to /login. Record CTA creates a session (/session/{uuid}) with transport, metronome BPM (100), and record button. Sessions list (/sessions) shows created take. No red-screens or crashes. Only added missing testID=metronome-screen to metronome.tsx to enable route assertion.

issues: Console warns: props.pointerEvents deprecated; shadow* and textShadow* style props deprecated on react-native-web. Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents / boxShadow / textShadow.

Nebula star generator emits <circle> negative radius errors in console (r values like -0.15, -0.4, -0.525). Non-blocking visually but noisy; clamp r to Math.max(0, ...) inside GalaxyBackground star generator.

action_items: Optional polish: sanitize star radius in GalaxyBackground so SVG <circle r> can never go negative (clamp with Math.max(0, r)).
Optional migration: replace deprecated props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents and shadow*/textShadow* with boxShadow/textShadow on RN Web to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx home node routing is data-driven and each entry has a unique route + testID; matches the 'distinct pathways' user requirement.
tool-screen.tsx cleanly powers Neural/Mixer/Reel/Collab/Looper/Songbook/Setlists with per-screen testID passed through - lightweight and DRY.
wordmark.tsx uses a single cubic-bezier Path for the lemniscate (true infinity), not two circles - matches the brand ask.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral email/password test accounts (nt{ts}@example.com / pw{ts}@example.com) via Sign Up UI; created one Take session via Record -> Start New Session (session id captured in URL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend routing, jam pathway, metronome, tuner, brand wordmark, paywall, sign-out all pass on Expo web preview. If retesting: register a new email each run, then start from '/', use goto('/') between nav checks (tool-back via router.back() can leave the record screen mounted in DOM causing 'not visible' on subsequent home taps). Backend was intentionally not re-tested this iteration.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. Added missing testID='metronome-screen' to /app/frontend/app/metronome.tsx outer container to allow the tab-metronome -> metronome-screen and jam-metronome -> metronome-screen route assertions from the review request.
